title: About KNSS - Keerthi Networks | Network Engineering & Security Specialists Chennai
description: Learn about KNSS (Keerthi Networks and Security Solution), Chennai's trusted data networking services and electronic security systems provider across Tamil Nadu.
intro: Keerthi Networks and Security Solution is a premier security technology and infrastructure solutions company headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. We help commercial enterprises, industrial facilities, institutions, and homes protect their people and property, communicate seamlessly, and operate on high-performance networks.

We engineer integrated solutions across five core domains — CCTV surveillance, intercom and video door phone systems, enterprise computer networking, biometric and access control, and fire safety systems. Because these systems increasingly communicate across shared infrastructure, having one accountable partner who understands all five ensures cleaner integration, tidy installations, and rapid, single-window support.

Our philosophy is rooted in engineering discipline: thoroughly survey the premises, specify genuine OEM components, install with neat structured cabling, and stand solidly behind every deployment with responsive after-sales support all over Tamil Nadu.
mission: To deliver reliable, well-engineered security, communication and networking solutions that make homes and workplaces safer and more connected — installed professionally and supported responsibly.
vision: To be the most trusted security and networking solutions partner in Chennai and across all of Tamil Nadu, recognized for technical excellence, transparent advice, and dependable service year after year.

values.title: Reliability First
values.text: We recommend systems we would trust on our own premises, installed to work dependably — not just on day one, but for years.

values.title: Honest, Transparent Advice
values.text: Clear itemised quotations and straightforward guidance. If something is unnecessary, we say so.

values.title: Engineering Discipline
values.text: Proper cabling, correct device placement and careful configuration. The quality is in the details.

values.title: Service Beyond Handover
values.text: Our relationship with a customer begins at installation, not ends there. We stay reachable and responsive.
